entities.name: Query secreted low-complexity protein
observations: 768 aa; estimated molecular weight 75.96 kDa, theoretical pI 4.94, and predicted net charge at pH 7 of -28.4.
N-terminal hydrophobic signal peptide is evident from residues 1-22, supporting entry into the secretory pathway.
Sequence contains a cysteine-rich N-terminal region followed by extensive glycine-, alanine-, serine-, asparagine-, lysine-, and acidic-residue-rich low-complexity/disordered sequence.
Closest reported Swiss-Prot hit is C. elegans G5EC21 at 100% identity over 53.6% query coverage; this is partial coverage and does not establish full-length identity or exact function.
No query Pfam domains were detected in the first sequence run; the result is non-diagnostic because the scan returned no result.

entities.name: UniProt G5EC21
observations: Reviewed C. elegans Protein qua-1, 1169 aa.
Annotated as required for cuticle shedding, normal alae morphology/localization, and subsequent larval development.
Annotated localization includes cytoplasmic vesicles, secretion, extracellular space, and extracellular matrix; secreted by underlying hypodermis.
Reviewed features include signal peptide residues 1-22 and extensive disordered/compositionally biased regions.
Curated GO cellular components include cuticular extracellular matrix, extracellular matrix, extracellular region, and cytoplasmic vesicle.
GO biological-process annotations include nematode molting/cuticle cycle and nematode larval development; protein autoprocessing and intein-mediated splicing are also listed in the retrieved record.
A Pfam hint PF01079.26 was reported at residues 958-1133 of the 1169-aa reference, but this feature was not mapped to the shorter query.

entities.name: Secreted cuticle-associated protein interpretation
observations: The combination of an N-terminal signal peptide, cysteine-rich N-terminal segment, and very long glycine/acidic/serine-rich low-complexity region is consistent with a secreted extracellular structural or matrix-associated protein.

The strongest functional hypothesis is association with nematode cuticle or extracellular matrix biology, based on the reviewed partial homolog qua-1; exact function remains uncertain because alignment coverage is incomplete.
